boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's card_rom.c, 0x02060890..0x02060f60: 11 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. ntrtwl/NitroSDK libraries/card/src/card_rom.c (and pret/pokediamond arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/CARD_rom.c) define CARDi_ReadFromCache, CARDi_SetRomOp, CARDi_SetCardDma, CARDi_OnReadCard, CARDi_TryReadCardDma, CARDi_ReadCard, CARDi_ReadRomIDCore, CARDi_ReadRomSyncCore, CARDi_ReadRom, CARD_Init, CARD_WaitRomAsync, CARD_TryWaitRomAsync and CARDi_GetRomAccessor; every one this ROM keeps compiles byte-identical from that file's bodies (CARDi_ReadFromCache, CARDi_SetRomOp, CARDi_ReadCard, CARDi_OnReadCard and CARDi_ReadRomSyncCore in the SDK's own spelling).

Order: built as C, mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse, so source order is the ROM's read top-down: CARDi_ReadFromCache, CARDi_ReadEnd, CARDi_SetRomOp, CARDi_SetCardDma, CARDi_OnReadCard, CARDi_TryReadCardDma, CARDi_ReadCard, CARDi_ReadRomSyncCore, CARDi_ReadRom, CARD_WaitRomAsync, CARD_Init. That is the SDK's order with two differences of this older SDK: CARDi_ReadEnd is a function of the file (the SDK's later card_rom.h makes it an inline that also runs the pulled-out check, which brings in CARDi_ReadRomIDCore), and CARD_WaitRomAsync precedes CARD_Init. CARDi_ReadRomIDCore, CARD_TryWaitRomAsync and CARDi_GetRomAccessor are not in this ROM (CARD_Init stores CARDi_ReadCard directly).

Statics: the SDK declares CARDi_ReadFromCache, CARDi_SetRomOp, CARDi_SetCardDma, CARDi_OnReadCard and CARDi_ReadRomSyncCore static, and CARDi_ReadEnd is header-private; all six are static here, none is inlined, and each config/arm9/symbols.txt row carries ` local`. Every caller of each is in this file.
Data: text-only. rom_stat (0x020a8780) is card_rom.c's, but no .bss is claimed; it stays an extern, as cardi_common does for arm9/CARD_Common.

BOTTOM EDGE: CARD_Init (0x02060890) is card_rom.c's in both SDK sources and installs rom_stat.read_func. Below it, CARDi_EndTask (0x0206081c) is the SDK's card_common.h helper, out of line in this SDK; its callers are CARDi_TaskThread (card_request.c, 0x020602bc) and the backup-request functions at 0x0206062c..0x0206081c, none of them in this file, and CARDi_ReadEnd carries its body inline rather than calling it.

TOP EDGE: CARDi_Request (0x02060f60) is card_request.c's in ntrtwl/NitroSDK; it does not touch rom_stat, and to sit above CARDi_ReadFromCache in this reversed file it would have to be defined first, ahead of the SDK file's first function. Its source is out of scope here (PR #5357 changes it). Above it, CARD_PullOut (src/engine/card/CARD_PullOut.cpp) starts at 0x020610ac.
